messages:
ryan (release lead): Heads up - we need an expedited deploy to fix OOMs in the inference-worker when sequence_len > 4096. Affects us-central1 embeddings jobs during long-batch experiments. Small code patch: bounds-check + guard. CI/e2e green locally. Requesting fastpass + pin to inference-worker:v2026.03-hotfix. Plan below.

deploy-bot: New deploy request recorded: jobs/deploy-worker/6543221111. Tests: ci/unit passed, canary smoke ok. Canary rollout plan: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% (8m windows). Auto-rollback: enabled.

lee (oncall): oncall here, will watch. Please add explicit rollback triggers and keep old tag around.

ryan (release lead): Rollback triggers: any sustained OOMs in worker logs > 0.5% of requests over 3m OR p99 latency > 1.2s for 5m. Tara to hold rollback toggle.

tara (eng-sre): I can own SRE gate. I'll create a short alert and set channel-wide paging for severity. I'll only permit traffic bump if no OOM counts in 3m sliding window.

otto (prod-eng): I can run the traffic swap. Proposed start 03:15 UTC. I'll execute steps manually and confirm after each window.

ryan (release lead): Quick security confirm: @sana, any concerns with the fix? It's just a defensive check, no new permissions.

sana (security): skimmed diff, looks ok. Approve. Keep release note minimal about mitigation.

dev (pm): customer impact: two customers reported failures. I'll be ready to update them after 25% success. Approve rollout.

ryan (release lead): pin command and rollback snippet: 

```
# pin hotfix image
/infra pin-service inference-worker --image inference-worker:v2026.03-hotfix --region us-central1

# rollback to previous stable
/infra rollback-service inference-worker --to-image inference-worker:v2026.02

# abort during rollout
/deploy abort jobs/deploy-worker/6543221111
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled to start at 03:15 UTC. Canary1 (1%) starting now. Job: jobs/deploy-worker/6543221111/c1. Logs: https://ci/internal/jobs/6543221111

otto (prod-eng): 1% live. Observing metrics.

lee (oncall): initial look - no OOMs. latency steady. go to 5% if SRE ok.

tara (eng-sre): alert hooks in place. No page. bump to 5%.

deploy-bot: Canary progress: scaled to 5% -> job jobs/deploy-worker/6543221111/c2.

otto (prod-eng): 5% live. small blip around +3m, looking like a GC pause, not OOMs. holding until full 8m.

lee (oncall): seeing one OOM in logs at +5m but traceback points to older image? double-checking.

tara (eng-sre): I'm triaging logs. Looks like the OOM came from a background batch still on v2026.02 due to sticky session. Not related to new image. No alert. continue to 25%.

deploy-bot: Scaling to 25% now. Canary job: jobs/deploy-worker/6543221111/c3.

otto (prod-eng): 25% live. rolling. I'll notify @dev after stable 8m.

lee (oncall): mid-window note: p99 slightly up (~200ms) but within tolerance. no OOMs.

sana (security): thumbs up from sec side.

tara (eng-sre): we did see a spike in retry errors at +6m, traced to a quota burst in upstream queue. I throttled a few producers and it's settled. No rollback.

dev (pm): I'll message the two customers: "We are deploying a fix for OOMs; rolling now and will confirm when fully rolled."

deploy-bot: 25% window passed. Promoting to 100%.

otto (prod-eng): starting final ramp to 100%. This will be manual 2-step 25% -> 50% -> 100% (we'll do 5m at 50% to be cautious).

tara (eng-sre): holding ready. If any OOM hits, I'll cut to 0% and trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted: 50% live. Monitoring...

lee (oncall): at +2m 50% window, we see a cluster of OOMs (approx 0.6% of requests). Tara, toggle?

tara (eng-sre): Saw it. Cutting traffic back to 10% now while I inspect. Rolling back parts of routing to keep older instances for failover.

ryan (release lead): pause and status please. What's the plan?

tara (eng-sre): Paused rollout. Root cause preliminary: our guard added an allocation check but missed a rare codepath in async prefetch; reproducing locally now. I'll patch and re-run canary on a subset. No full rollback yet; cutting traffic kept 10% so we don't break running jobs.

otto (prod-eng): I pinned old image in registry and moved half of the 10% traffic to previous tag for safety.

ryan (release lead): okay let's move fast. Can we hot-fix a 1-line guard and re-run 1% canary? Tara, ETA?

tara (eng-sre): I have a patch; running unit tests. ETA ~9m to build and push. I'll request a micro-canary: 1% on a fresh job.

sana (security): rerun quick sec scan on the tiny change.

deploy-robot: New micro-canary requested: jobs/deploy-worker/6543221111/micro1. CI quick checks running.

deploy-bot: micro-canary image built and pushed: inference-worker:v2026.03-hotfix-1. Micro canary 1% started.

otto (prod-eng): micro 1% live.

lee (oncall): monitoring micro - no OOMs after 6m. p99 ok.

tara (eng-sre): micro looks clean. I'll greenlight step to 10% and then resume normal taper.

deploy-bot: micro-canary success. Promoting to 10% -> jobs/deploy-worker/6543221111/c2b.

otto (prod-eng): 10% live. slowly ramping.

lee (oncall): all metrics stable, no OOMs at 10% for 8m. Clear to continue.

ryan (release lead): all approvals reconfirmed. tara, thanks for the quick triage.

tara (eng-sre): np. final ramp to 100% started. I'll leave alerts tightened for 30m post-rollout.

deploy-bot: Final rollout complete: 100% -> jobs/deploy-worker/6543221111/complete.

otto (prod-eng): 100% done. Baseline metrics look good.

dev (pm): Notified customers that fix is deployed; they replied confirming.

sana (security): no issues.

ryan (release lead): I'll update release notes and pin the stable tag. Thanks team. Closing thread; will open follow-up if SRE finds anything in the 30m post window.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: inference-worker -> inference-worker:v2026.03-hotfix-1 (region us-central1).

ryan (release lead): resolving. :white_check_mark:
